description_en: Retrieves the uplink and downlink data packets of a specific node
description_zh: 调用GetNodeTransferPacket获取某条节点上下行数据包
kebab_example: aliyun linkwan get-node-transfer-packet --iot-instance-id iot-cn-0pp1n8t0000 --dev-eui 0000000000000001 --base64-encoded-mac-payload SGVsbG8hIQ== --log-millis 1514736000000 --api-version 2019-03-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetNodeTransferPacket

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the Alibaba Cloud Link WAN console. If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.

> If the public instance does not have an ID value, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).
parameters.description_zh:
实例ID。
您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。
